item.title: Ellis County Special Olympics team successful at Winter Games
item.description: The Ellis County United Special Olympics powerlifting team travelled to Bee Cave, Texas to compete in the Texas Winter Games on Saturday, Feb. 14. The Ellis County team sent a team of 5 men and 5 women to compete for state titles. The team competed against 154 other lifters from across the State of Texas and earned 24 gold medals, 10 silver, (1) 4th and (5) 5th place medals. Rubin Ybarra of ECU won 4 Gold Medals.

item.title: Tribe outlasts Eagles for playoff berth
item.description: The Waxahachie Runnin’ Indians are back in the playoffs — thanks entirely to a gutsy effort in double overtime on Tuesday night at Mike Turner Gymnasium.
